changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'AssetDisplayValue') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[AssetDisplayValue]( [AssetID] [bigint] NOT NULL, [DisplayValue] [nvarchar](max) NOT NULL, [DisplayValueHash] [nvarchar](50) NULL, [DisplayValuePrefix] [nvarchar](250) NOT NULL, [UpdatedOn] [datetime] CONSTRAINT [DF_AssetDisplayValue_UpdatedOn] DEFAULT (getutcdate()) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_AssetDisplayValue] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [AssetID] ASC ) ) END
IF EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_AssetDisplayValue_AssetID') BEGIN DROP INDEX [IX_AssetDisplayValue_AssetID] ON [dbo].[AssetDisplayValue]; END
IF EXISTS (select 1 from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[TABLE_CONSTRAINTS] where Table_Name = 'AssetDisplayValue' and constraint_name = 'PK_AssetDisplayValue') AND EXISTS (select 1 from sys.indexes where name = 'PK_AssetDisplayValue' and type_desc = 'NONCLUSTERED') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[AssetDisplayValue] DROP CONSTRAINT [PK_AssetDisplayValue]; END
IF NOT EXISTS (select 1 from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[TABLE_CONSTRAINTS] where Table_Name = 'AssetDisplayValue' and constraint_name = 'PK_AssetDisplayValue') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[AssetDisplayValue] ADD CONSTRAINT [PK_AssetDisplayValue] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [AssetID] ASC ) END

changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS ( select 1 from [sys].[fulltext_indexes] i inner join [sys].[objects] o on o.object_id = i.object_id and o.Name = 'AssetDisplayValue' ) BEGIN CREATE FULLTEXT INDEX ON dbo.AssetDisplayValue(DisplayValue) KEY INDEX PK_AssetDisplayValue ON fullTextCatalog END
